title: Roles and Contract Boundaries
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Roles and Contract Boundaries.
learning_objectives: Explain roles and contract boundaries using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for roles and contract boundaries
Assess failure and operational limits of roles and contract boundaries
concepts_covered: A contract is a public rulebook that holds state and permits defined roles to act.
Escrow distinguishes buyer, seller, and arbiter; TokenizedAsset uses AccessControl roles for minting/auditing and Pausable controls.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
